programs.desc: The host sheds light on Indian culture by travelling across the country to explore food, rituals, traditions and some rare talents.

programs.title: Firepower: Defending India
programs.sub_title: Take a look at how Indian troops brave icy weathers of the Siachen Glacier and how the Medical Corps evacuates an injured soldier
programs.desc: The narrator sheds light on the various facets of the Indian Army that help them to defend the country including strategies, specialists, weapons and technologies.

programs.title: Counting Cars
programs.sub_title: Danny inspects a collection featuring a 1993 Ford Roadster and 1953 Henry J. Later, Kevin, Ryan and Mike experience the strain of proving their unauthorized purchase's worth
programs.desc: When Rick Harrison and the rest of the \"Pawn Stars\" gang need to restore a vehicle they're buying, they sometimes turn to Danny \"The Count\" Koker, who runs Las Vegas auto shop Count's Kustoms. The Count now gets his own half-hour show that showcases his ability to restore and customize classic rides. When he sees a vehicle he wants, whether it's at an auto auction or at a roadside diner, Koker does all he can to acquire it. When successful, he and his team then work to restore and modify the cars and motorcycles to quickly flip them for a profit. From classic cars like Thunderbirds and Corvettes to sidecar motorcycles and everything in between, if it has wheels, the Count's Kustoms team can make it look spectacular.

programs.title: India: Marvels \u0026 Mysteries With William Dalrymple
programs.desc: The host, William Dalrymple, travels across India to uncover previously unknown information about its ancient civilisation.

programs.title: The Einstein Challenge
programs.sub_title: Subject-matter experts Mike Nelson and Matthew Cappucci explain various weather events like the formation of sinkholes, thundersnow and the supercell tornado
programs.desc: Two world-class experts compete to best explain seriously complicated concepts to a panel of kids.

programs.title: Food Tech
programs.sub_title: Delving deep into the culture and making of pasta, the host forages the various ingredients required to prepare the delicious Italian dish
programs.desc: Big fan of pancakes? Live for Chinese takeout? Craving a cheeseburger and fries? Now you can trace the origins of some of your favorite foods. Host Bobby Bognar takes viewers on a journey from farm to plate to show them how some of their favorite foods come to be.

programs.title: The Fast History Of
programs.sub_title: The documentarian tells the story of the most successful pizza franchise on the planet, which includes drones, muscle cars and a lot of dough
programs.desc: The histories of anything from iconic brands like Nike, Domino's and Nintendo to the topics like the mob, UFOs and the secret lives of billionaires.

programs.title: Forged in Fire

programs.desc: Top bladesmiths from different walks of life compete to create the best weapons and prove their effectiveness in a series of daunting challenges.
